rate: 1/4 cup steeped per gallon of water
notes: Gentle, low-nitrogen feed suited to native perennial beds; avoid over-fertilizing to keep growth compact. Note: a whole-lawn version of this recipe (1 tbsp kelp meal or 1 tsp liquid extract per gallon, applied 1 gal/100 sq ft every 2-3 weeks) appears in the Brunswick lawn-care rotation reference material as an optional/complementary input, but kelp is not one of the six inputs in the active rotation documented in annual-organic-lawn-care-rotation-brunswick-zone-9a - use this lower-concentration bed-scale rate for perennials, and see kelp-tea-foliar-bloom-booster for the higher-strength bloom-program variant.
